operaciones.texto:
query Alarm(
    $country: String!
    $project: String!
    $language: String!
    $cinema: [String!]!
  ) {
    alarms(
      country: $country
      project: $project
      language: $language
      cinema: $cinema
    ) {
      alarmCode
      countryCode
      project
      title
      description
      active
      color
      language
    }
  }

mutation AddConcession(
    $cinema: JSONString!
    $concessions: [ConcessionInput]!
    $deliveryInfo: DeliveryInfoInput
    $country: String!
    $orderId: String
    $orderUserId: String!
  ) {
    addConcession(
      cinema: $cinema
      deliveryInfo: $deliveryInfo
      concessions: $concessions
      country: $country
      orderId: $orderId
      orderUserId: $orderUserId
    ) {
      order {
        cinemaVistaId
        cinemaName
        cinemaId
        cinemaType
        orderUserId
        foods
        total
        charges
        subtotal
      }
    }
  }

mutation UpdateConcession(
    $cinema: JSONString!
    $concessions: [ConcessionInput]!
    $deliveryInfo: DeliveryInfoInput
    $country: String!
    $orderId: String!
    $orderUserId: String!
  ) {
    updateConcession(
      cinema: $cinema
      deliveryInfo: $deliveryInfo
      concessions: $concessions
      country: $country
      orderId: $orderId
      orderUserId: $orderUserId
    ) {
      order {
        cinemaVistaId
        cinemaName
        cinemaId
        cinemaType
        orderUserId
        foods
        total
        charges
        subtotal
      }
    }
  }

query GetRecommendations($countryId: String!, $cinema: String!, $userSessionId: String!, $userAction: String!) {
    getRecommendations(                                            
        country: $countryId,                                                       
        cinema: $cinema,                                                        
        userSessionId: $userSessionId,                                   
        userAction: $userAction                                                
    ) {                                                               
        showRecommendations                                                   
        recommendationType                                                   
        recommendations {                                                   
            product                                                                  
            productName                                                              
            price                                                                      
            discount                                                                 
            productDescription                                                        
            productStructure                                                      
            productType                                                              
            category                                                                
            tag                                                                      
            promotionType                                                           
            active                                                                  
            sellable                                                                
            resource {                                                             
                web {    
                    promotional      
                    normal           
                    wide             
                    icon             
                }        
            }                                                                      
        }                                                                   
    }                                                               
}
